app.name: Flanr
app.tagline: Track and rate the cities you visit.

home.title: Every city you have been to, in one place
home.lead: Log your visits, rate cities on what matters to you and see your travels on a map.

log.title: Log your visits
log.text: Mark the cities you have been to, with a date or without, and the ones you have lived in.

rate.title: Rate cities
rate.text: Rate a city on what matters to you and see how others rate it.

map.title: Your map
map.text: See your cities by visits, by rating or by population.

calendar.title: Your trip calendar
calendar.text: Every day you travelled, in one picture of the year.

visitForm.beforeRegistration: This visit was before I joined Flanr on {date}
visitForm.undatedNote: Visits after you joined need a date, so that they count in your trip statistics.

onboarding.dateHint: A date can be a year, a month or a day: 2018, 2018-05 or 2018-05-10. The other visits are saved without a date.
